Formula: Server_Feasible = Capacity_OK AND Configuration_OK AND Compatibility_OK AND Power_OK AND Cooling_OK AND Rack_OK
Variables: Capacity_OK; Configuration_OK; Compatibility_OK; Power_OK; Cooling_OK; Rack_OK
Variable_Definitions: Boolean checks produced by the applicable server-level capacity, configuration, compatibility, power, cooling and rack rules.
Inputs: Applicable workload resource requirements; selected server configuration; server catalogue capacities/constraints; deployment power/cooling/rack constraints; compatibility evidence
Source_Type: Derived DSS logic supported by Hardware Catalogue + Research + Official Vendor evidence
Exact_Page_Section_Table_Equation: Derived from SRV-001–SRV-022 and SRV-026; research supports multi-resource feasibility; vendor sources support configuration-specific constraints
Applicability: Server-level screening after component-specific rules and deployment constraints have been evaluated.
Limitations: This is a DSS integration formula, not a formula published verbatim by a source. It must not be interpreted as a performance model or optimization objective.
